extends SceneTree
const Snapshot=preload("res://scripts/progression/run_snapshot.gd")
const Supplies=preload("res://tests/test_supplies.gd")
const Textures=preload("res://tests/test_portrait_reactions.gd")
const FOLDER:="res://.local_validation/GAME056/render-live"
var ui
var errors:Array=[]
var records:Array=[]
var mouse_controls:=0
func expect(ok:bool,label:String):
 if not ok:errors.append(label)
func _initialize():call_deferred("run")
func touch(id:int,at:Vector2,pressed:bool,canceled:bool=false):
 var event:=InputEventScreenTouch.new()
 event.index=id
 event.position=at
 event.pressed=pressed
 event.canceled=canceled
 Input.parse_input_event(event)
func click(control:Control):
 mouse_controls+=1
 await process_frame
 await process_frame
 if ui._scroll.is_ancestor_of(control):ui._scroll.ensure_control_visible(control)
 await process_frame
 await process_frame
 var at:Vector2=control.get_global_rect().get_center()
 var motion:=InputEventMouseMotion.new()
 motion.position=at
 Input.parse_input_event(motion)
 var event:=InputEventMouseButton.new()
 event.button_index=MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT
 event.position=at
 event.pressed=true
 Input.parse_input_event(event)
 await process_frame
 event=event.duplicate()
 event.pressed=false
 Input.parse_input_event(event)
 await process_frame
func resize(size:Vector2i,inset:float=0):
 root.content_scale_mode=Window.CONTENT_SCALE_MODE_DISABLED
 root.content_scale_size=size
 root.size=size
 DisplayServer.window_set_size(size)
 ui.root_ui.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
 ui.root_ui.size=Vector2(size)
 ui.safe_area_override=Rect2(Vector2(inset,6),Vector2(size)-Vector2(inset*2,18))
 ui._apply_layout()
 await process_frame
 await process_frame
 ui._apply_layout()
func capture(tag:String):
 ui._update_hud();ui.view.queue_redraw()
 var state:Dictionary=Snapshot.capture(ui.simulation);var clocks:Dictionary=ui.simulation.feedback.clocks.duplicate(true)
 await process_frame;await process_frame;await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
 expect(root.get_texture().get_image().save_png(FOLDER.path_join(tag+".png"))==OK,"capture "+tag)
 expect(Snapshot.capture(ui.simulation)==state and ui.simulation.feedback.clocks==clocks,"render read only "+tag)
 records.append({"tag":tag,"expression":ui.feedback_panel.expression_key,"feedback":ui.feedback_panel.state_key,"portrait_visible":ui.feedback_panel.portrait.visible,"exact_art":ui.feedback_panel.expression_has_art,"danger":ui.feedback_panel.danger_text.text,"phase":ui.simulation.phase,"hp":ui.simulation.hp,"viewport":str(root.size),"oblique":ui.view.uses_oblique(),"occluders":ui.view.high_renderer.stats.get("occluders",0),"camera":str(ui.view.camera_center()),"animation":str(ui.view.actor_visual().sample.get("animation","")),"frame":int(ui.view.actor_visual().sample.get("index",-1)),"pose":str(ui.view.actor_visual().get("pose","")),"clock":float(ui.view.actor_visual().get("clock",0))})
func step(count:int):
 for i in range(count):ui._physics_process(.05);await process_frame
func hp_item():
 var item:Dictionary=Supplies.drop(ui.simulation,"hp");item.p=ui.simulation.player;ui._physics_process(.01)
func run():
 DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(FOLDER)
 ui=load("res://scenes/main.tscn").instantiate()
 ui.run_store.path=FOLDER.path_join("battle.save");ui.gold_progress.path=FOLDER.path_join("gold.cfg");ui.settings_path=FOLDER.path_join("settings.cfg")
 for path in [ui.run_store.path,ui.gold_progress.path,ui.settings_path]:DirAccess.remove_absolute(path)
 root.add_child(ui);ui.set_physics_process(false);await process_frame;await resize(Vector2i(1280,720))
 await click(ui.start_button);await click(ui.stage_launch_button)
 var s=ui.simulation
 s.spawn_clock=999;s.shot_clock=999;s._scatter_clock=999;s._swarm_clock=999
 s.player=Vector2(2500,1700);ui.view.camera.reset(s.run_id)
 var resource:String="res://assets/characters/pilot_32/resources/viya_directional_motion.tres"
 expect(ui.view.art.definitions.viya_battle==resource,"real departure reads the shipped production slot")
 ui.view.art.definitions.viya_battle="";await capture("before")
 ui.view.art.definitions.viya_battle=resource;ui._physics_process(.01);await capture("idle_e")
 var directions:Array=["e","se","s","sw","w","nw","n","ne"]
 var coverage:Array=[]
 for index in range(8):
  var key:String=directions[index]
  var screen_direction:=Vector2.from_angle(index*PI/4)
  var anchor:Vector2=ui.movement.get_global_transform_with_canvas()*ui.layout_data.move.get_center()
  touch(20+index,anchor,true);await process_frame
  var drag:=InputEventScreenDrag.new();drag.index=20+index;drag.position=anchor+screen_direction*60;Input.parse_input_event(drag);await process_frame
  ui._physics_process(.03);ui._physics_process(.03)
  expect(ui.view.actor_visual().sample.animation=="run_"+key,"native joystick run:"+key)
  if key in ["e","ne"]:await capture("run_"+key)
  touch(20+index,anchor,false);await process_frame;ui._physics_process(.01)
  expect(ui.view.actor_visual().sample.animation=="idle_"+key,"native release idle:"+key)
  var toward:Vector2=ui.view.input_direction(screen_direction)
  s.enemies.clear();s.add_enemy(s.player+toward*250);s.enemies[-1].speed=0
  var shots:int=s.shots;s.shot_clock=0;ui._physics_process(.01)
  expect(s.shots==shots+1 and ui.view.actor_visual().sample.animation=="attack_"+key,"real shot and attack:"+key)
  if key in ["e","ne"]:await capture("attack_"+key)
  s.hurt_clock=0;s.damage_player(1,"physical",0,{"kind":"contact","id":s.enemies[-1].id,"p":s.player+toward*100});ui._physics_process(.01)
  expect(ui.view.actor_visual().sample.animation=="hurt_"+key,"accepted received event:"+key)
  if key in ["e","ne"]:await capture("hurt_"+key)
  coverage.append({"direction":key,"run":true,"idle":true,"attack":true,"hurt":true})
  s.enemies.clear();s.shot_clock=999;await step(4)
 expect(coverage.size()==8,"all32actual pose/direction combinations exercised")
 # Controlled accepted repeated hit while already hurting; preserves the native final frame.
 var toward:Vector2=ui.view.input_direction(Vector2(1,-1).normalized())
 s.hurt_clock=0;s.damage_player(1,"physical",0,{"kind":"contact","id":1,"p":s.player+toward*100});ui._physics_process(.01);await step(2)
 s.hurt_clock=0;s.damage_player(1,"physical",0,{"kind":"contact","id":1,"p":s.player+toward*100});ui._physics_process(.02)
 expect(ui.view.actor_visual().sample.index==5 and ui.view.actor_visual().sample.animation=="hurt_ne","re-hit retains supplied hurt final frame")
 await capture("rehit")
 ui.pause_game();var saved:Dictionary=Snapshot.capture(s);var before:Dictionary=ui.view.actor_visual();await step(5)
 expect(Snapshot.capture(s)==saved and ui.view.actor_visual().clock==before.clock,"pause freezes authoritative state and sprite clock")
 expect(ui.battle_save_error==OK and DirAccess.copy_absolute(ui.run_store.path,FOLDER.path_join("sprite.save"))==OK,"original atomic save accepts the progressed run with sprite phase unsaved")
 await click(ui.resume_button);ui._physics_process(.01)
 s.add_pickup(s.player,s.growth.threshold());ui._physics_process(.01)
 saved=Snapshot.capture(s);before=ui.view.actor_visual();await step(4)
 expect(Snapshot.capture(s)==saved and ui.view.actor_visual().clock==before.clock,"skill choice freezes sprite time and same offer")
 await capture("choice")
 while s.phase==s.Phase.CHOOSING:
  await click(ui.choice_buttons[0]);ui._physics_process(.01)
 var key:=InputEventKey.new();key.pressed=true;key.keycode=KEY_F8;ui._unhandled_key_input(key)
 expect(not ui.view.high_angle and not ui.view.actor_visual().sample.is_empty(),"actual F8 draws supplied body in original renderer")
 await capture("f8");ui._unhandled_key_input(key)
 await resize(Vector2i(960,540),12);await capture("compact")
 var report:Dictionary={"status":"PASS" if errors.is_empty() else "FAIL","errors":errors,"screens":records,"coverage":coverage,"native_touch_directions":8,"mouse_controls":mouse_controls,"source_slot":resource,"schema":Snapshot.VERSION,"fingerprint":Snapshot.fingerprint(),"scope":"Real supplied production slot, actual native joystick/shot events and controlled accepted damage/re-hit. Not natural full run/mobile hardware or final art approval."}
 var f=FileAccess.open(FOLDER.path_join("report.json"),FileAccess.WRITE);f.store_string(JSON.stringify(report,"  "));f.close();print(JSON.stringify(report))
 ui.combat_audio.stop_all();await create_timer(.06).timeout;ui.queue_free();await process_frame;await create_timer(.1).timeout;quit(0 if errors.is_empty() else 1)
